section_summary.extract_value: This section describes a single study (no explicit 'Study 1' label) of 3,621 undergraduate females at a large publicly-funded institution in the Southeastern United States. Mean age was 19.4 years (SD = 1.5); racial composition was 62% White, 21% Black, with smaller percentages of Asian (4%), Hispanic/Latina (6%), multi-ethnic (6%), American Indian/Alaska Native (<1%), and Other (1%); mean BMI was 23.5 kg/m2 (SD = 4.9) with 26.8% having BMI ≥ 25. The sample consisted largely of freshmen/sophomores (76.5%) and 86.5% were non-psychology majors; the section does not report body appreciation assessment instrument, BMI measurement method, survey mode, or correlations between body appreciation and BMI.
